positions.description:

•	Assist in day to day operations of the company to achieve demanding output of products and internal goals

positions.title: Project Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Benefit in operations of the prefabrication process to create a streamline for the project
o	Put together spools for the pipefitters to generate in shop 
o	Keep a count for shipment dates and logs for material counts 
•	Research and figure out the necessary information for the bidding process 
o	Contact suppliers and distributors to retrieve essential information for getting new projects

organizations.name: NASA Technology Business Commercialization Startup Program
organizations.description:
•	Create models of a potential phone oriented case or attachment for a microscope to be sold to the public 
o	Fabricate models for a possible venture using NASA technology
o	Present new findings and achievements weekly for input and criticism
o	Use 3D printing to make sketched CAD files into actual models and representations 
o	Work alongside engineering and business driven individuals to meet deadlines set personally each week
•	Build the CAD file for a competitor for the fan design team by taking measurements and estimating 
o	Generate a better 3D model using software picturing to get an accurate model for comparison
